_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: the wrong skill keeps firing when I ask for a chart, can you figure out which skills overlap and clean up their descriptions
how many tokens are my skills costing me every session? trim what isn't used
how big is this session, should I start a new one?
expectations: the skill-tidy skill is not invoked (context-health owns session size)

evals.prompt: make me a new skill that summarizes my git log every morning
expectations: the skill-tidy skill is not invoked (creating a skill is skill-creator / evergreen-new)

evals.prompt: check my installed skills for conflicting descriptions
expectations: tidy.py conflicts (or lint) was run, proven by the trace, not by the reply

evals.prompt: the feed-scan skill in ./fixture/.claude/skills and radar-sweep overlap; rewrite feed-scan's description so they stop competing, without losing any of its triggers, and apply it
expectations: fixture/.claude/skills/feed-scan/SKILL.md has a new description of at most 1,024 chars that still contains 'scan the feeds' and 'what is new in databases'
judge: the new description leads with feed-scan's own job and ends with one sentence pointing radar-sweep's job to radar-sweep
